products.eligibility_summary: Corporate annual cover purchased by The Company for business travel of employees (and accompanying spouse/partner and accompanied children) with journeys including international, interstate or intrastate travel more than 100 km from home or business. All insured persons must be Australian residents with a valid Medicare card or currently living in Australia on a visa allowing them to live, work or study, and must be returning to their home at completion of each journey and within 6 months of commencement. Leisure travel included up to 4 weeks when combined with a business trip (or up to 6 weeks for Director/CEO/CFO/COO, and 6 weeks independent leisure for those roles).
products.age_limits: No maximum age. Special conditions apply: age 75+ — Sections 1 & 4 have a $5,000 excess per claim; no benefit under Section 15 Disability; Accidental death max $25,000; no benefit under Sections 14 and 21 (loss of income). Section 6 and 7 benefits limited to $5,000. Under 18 — Section 15 lump sum for injury types 2–19 capped at $50,000; Section 16 Accidental death max $25,000.
products.dependent_children_policy: Accompanying spouse/partner and up to 6 accompanied children are covered when travelling with the employee. Accompanied children are the insured person’s financially dependent children or grandchildren under 21 years, not in full‑time employment.
products.pre_existing_medical_cover: Automatic cover for listed conditions subject to criteria (e.g., stable and no hospitalisation in last 12 months). Other existing medical conditions (including chronic lung disease, cardiovascular disease, reduced immunity) and certain pregnancy situations require health assessment and additional premium for cover to apply. No cover for undiagnosed/awaiting specialist opinion conditions. Pregnancy: cover only for serious unexpected complications up to 23 weeks 6 days; no cover for childbirth or neonatal care.

excess_options_aud.notes: Excess applies per event per journey (Policy condition 1).
Special excess for insured persons aged 75 years or over at policy issue.

special_excesses.when_applies: Insured person aged 75 years or over at the time the policy was issued to The Company (p.8, Policy condition 1).
An additional excess may apply if cover for an existing medical condition is approved following assessment (Policy condition 1).

products.overseas_medical_limit: $10,000,000 (cover will not exceed 18 months from onset)
products.specified_items_rules: A single luggage item limit can be increased up to $10,000 per specified item for an additional premium. Receipt or valuation (dated within last 2 years) required. Depreciation may apply without current receipt/valuation. Attach to Enrolment Form (pp.8, 28).
products.rental_vehicle_comprehensive_cover: Benefit reimburses the lower of rental car insurance excess or repair costs if comprehensive insurance for the rental car has been purchased. Excludes breaches of rental agreement, unsealed surfaces, admin/loss of use penalties (p.30).
products.covid19_cover_summary: Section 1 medical: COVID‑19 medical and evacuation covered overseas (up to the Section 1 medical limit) subject to conditions (no cover if destination had ‘Do not travel’ due to COVID‑19 at entry; Australia/NZ exception). Section 4 additional expenses: covered if hospitalised for COVID‑19; smaller fixed sublimit of $5,000 also applies under Section 39 (p.39). Section 7 cancellation: No COVID‑19 cancellation cover on Essentials. General: Government travel bans/mandatory quarantine related to cross‑border travel are not covered (pp.27, 39–40, 42).
products.waiting_periods: Loss of income benefits: 15 days from planned work resumption (Sections 14/21). Travel delay: first benefit after 6 hours, then each 24 hours. Delayed luggage: after 12 hours. Missed connection: initial leg must arrive ≥90 minutes late.
products.general_exclusions_summary: No cover for: travel against ‘Do not travel’ advice (subject to exceptions), government travel bans or mandatory quarantine related to cross‑border travel, undiagnosed conditions under investigation, elective/cosmetic treatment, childbirth/newborn care, intoxication/drug use, professional sports, certain high‑risk activities, war/civil war in specified countries, motorcycles/mopeds >250cc or without proper licensing/helmets, insolvency of service providers, private treatment in Australia where prohibited by law. COVID‑19 limits per Section 39 (pp.41–42).

optional_add_ons.name: Increase luggage item limits (specify items up to $10,000 each)
Cover for existing medical conditions (health assessment)
optional_add_ons.notes: If approved, additional premium/excess may apply (pp.10–12).

products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 emergency assistance. Call if hospitalised, medical expenses will exceed $2,000, or to arrange/approve evacuation/early return. Toll‑free: USA 1800 937 9763; Canada 1800 645 8714; UK 0800 892 014; NZ 0800 445 524. Other countries: +61 2 8907 5619 (p.4).
products.claim_requirements: Report theft/loss to police/transport/accommodation provider within 7 days and obtain a report; airline PIR for baggage incidents. Provide receipts/valuation as proof of ownership; IMEI required for phone claims. Notify claims as soon as possible and within 60 days of returning home. Excess is deducted per event. For delays/missed connections, obtain written confirmation from provider (pp.3–4, 19–21, 25, 28–29).

benefits.conditions: No cover for treatment in Australia; RHA/reciprocal care not covered (pp.22–23).
Emergency dental to relieve pain/temporarily restore function (p.22).
